name: ai-toolkit
description: ITSolve-dev shared AI toolkit — reusable skills, agents and plugins across projects.

plugins.name: llm-wiki
plugins.description: LLM-maintained knowledge wiki following Andrej Karpathy's llm-wiki pattern: ingest sources, compile durable pages, query, lint. Includes the wiki-keeper expert agent, a local browser preview, and adapters for the common source formats.

plugins.name: domain-driven-guide
plugins.description: Domain-Driven Design guidance grounded in a curated knowledge base bundled with the plugin: questions answered with citations, and skills for modelling and reviewing a domain.

plugins.name: spec-driven-guide
plugins.description: The theory half of development driven by documents: writing design docs, decision records and agent instructions that shed implementation mechanism while keeping their obligations. Grounded in a curated knowledge base bundled with the plugin, and checked by a fan-out review of what was written.

plugins.name: anti-sycophancy
plugins.description: Assessment that does not bend toward what the user wants to hear. Ships honest-assessment, the methodology loaded into the current context and attachable to other plugins' agents, and second-opinion, a reviewer forked into a context that never helped build the idea.
